data.title: Simon Property Group’s Strong Momentum and Leasing Pipeline Support Buy Rating; $260 Target Maintained
data.description:
Caitlin Burrows, an analyst from Goldman Sachs, maintained the Buy rating on Simon Property. The associated price target remains the same with $260.00.

Caitlin Burrows’s rating is based on Simon Property Group’s strong operating momentum and favorable leasing backdrop. Domestic property NOI rose 7.3% year to date through the third quarter of 2026, supported by Taubman margin gains, better occupancy, higher rents, overage income, and redevelopment. The planned replacement of Saks Off 5th space should further enhance future earnings as the re-leased area is expected to generate substantially higher rent.

Management also reported a leasing pipeline up about 30% year over year, indicating retailers continue to seek space and giving Simon scope to improve its tenant mix. Stable luxury demand, resilient consumers, and healthy mall traffic could support sales and provide upside to guidance, while the company sees AI-driven leisure spending as an additional tailwind. Against this backdrop, Burrows maintained the Buy rating and left the price target unchanged at $260.

In another report released on November 15, Bank of America Securities also reiterated a Buy rating on the stock with a $260.00 price target.
